_about: Public-domain Henry Wace (1836-1924), Principal of King's College London and Dean of Canterbury, for the Word Hoard: his Boyle and Bampton lectures, his reviews and replies to Huxley in Christianity and Agnosticism, his Warburton lectures on prophecy, Principles of the Reformation, and his sermons and addresses to The Story of the Resurrection (1923). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 69 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

wace-christianity-and-morality: Christianity and morality, or, The correspondence of the gospel with the moral nature of man (London : B.M. Pickering, 1877)
wace-foundations-of-faith: The foundations of faith considered in eight sermons preached before the University of Oxford in the year MDCCCLXXIX (London : Pickering & Co., 1880)
wace-gospel-and-its-witnesses: The Gospel and its witnesses : some of the chief facts in the life of our Lord and the authority of the evangelical narratives considered in lectures chiefly preached at St. James's, Westminster (London : J. Murray, 1883)
wace-central-points: Some central points of our Lord's ministry (London : Hodder and Stoughton, 1890)
wace-christianity-and-agnosticism: Christianity and agnosticism; reviews of some recent attacks on the Christian faith (New York, T. Whittaker; Edinburgh [etc.] W. Blackwood and sons, 1895)
wace-sacrifice-of-christ: The sacrifice of Christ, its vital reality and efficacy (New York, Macmillan, 1898)
wace-bible-modern-investigation: The Bible and modern investigation : three lectures delivered to clergy at Norwich at the request of the Bishop with an address on the authority of Holy Scripture (London : Society for Promoting Christian Knowledge, 1903)
wace-principles-reformation: Principles of the Reformation, Practical and Historical (New York: American Tract Society, undated; library-catalogued 1911; first published 1910)
wace-prophecy: Prophecy, Jewish and Christian : considered in a series of Warburton lectures at Lincoln's Inn (Milwaukee : Young Churchman, 1911)
wace-christian-sanction-of-war: The Christian sanction of war, address at the service of intercession for the King's Naval and Military forces, held in Canterbury Cathedral, August 9th, 1914 (London, Thynne, 1914)
wace-war-and-gospel: The war and the gospel : sermons & addresses during the present war (London : C.J. Thynne, 1917)
wace-story-of-passion: The story of the passion : its own message considered in addresses (London : John Murray, 1922)
wace-story-of-resurrection: The Story of the Resurrection (London: John Murray; undated in this scan, catalogued 1923)

_excluded.wace-edited: works he edited or co-edited (Dictionary of Christian Biography, Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers second series, the Speaker's Commentary Apocrypha, Church and Faith, the Fulham conference reports); Christianity and Agnosticism: a Controversy (1889, papers by several hands); First Principles of the Reformation (1883, his and Buchheim's translation of Luther)
